changelog.en: The installer now checks the Power PDF fix pack: the Add-on Store needs Power PDF 2025.3.7 or later. On an older version, setup stops with a clear message instead of installing a store that Power PDF does not show.
changelog.de: Das Setup prüft jetzt das Fix Pack von Power PDF: Der Add-on Store braucht Power PDF 2025.3.7 oder neuer. Bei einer älteren Version bricht das Setup mit einem klaren Hinweis ab, statt einen Store zu installieren, den Power PDF nicht anzeigt.
changelog.fr: Le programme d'installation vérifie désormais le correctif de Power PDF : l'Add-on Store nécessite Power PDF 2025.3.7 ou une version ultérieure. Sur une version plus ancienne, l'installation s'arrête avec un message clair au lieu d'installer un store que Power PDF n'affiche pas.
changelog.it: Il programma di installazione ora controlla il fix pack di Power PDF: l'Add-on Store richiede Power PDF 2025.3.7 o successivo. Con una versione precedente l'installazione si interrompe con un messaggio chiaro, invece di installare uno store che Power PDF non mostra.
changelog.es: El instalador ahora comprueba el paquete de correcciones de Power PDF: Add-on Store necesita Power PDF 2025.3.7 o posterior. En una versión anterior, la instalación se detiene con un mensaje claro en lugar de instalar una tienda que Power PDF no muestra.
changelog.nl: Het installatieprogramma controleert nu het fixpack van Power PDF: de Add-on Store heeft Power PDF 2025.3.7 of later nodig. Bij een oudere versie stopt de installatie met een duidelijke melding, in plaats van een store te installeren die Power PDF niet toont.
changelog.pt: O instalador verifica agora o pacote de correções do Power PDF: a Add-on Store precisa do Power PDF 2025.3.7 ou posterior. Numa versão mais antiga, a instalação para com uma mensagem clara, em vez de instalar uma loja que o Power PDF não mostra.
changelog.da: Installationsprogrammet kontrollerer nu Power PDF-rettelsespakken: Add-on Store kræver Power PDF 2025.3.7 eller nyere. På en ældre version stopper installationen med en tydelig besked i stedet for at installere en butik, som Power PDF ikke viser.
changelog.fi: Asennusohjelma tarkistaa nyt Power PDF:n korjauspaketin: Add-on Store vaatii Power PDF 2025.3.7:n tai uudemman. Vanhemmassa versiossa asennus pysähtyy selkeään ilmoitukseen sen sijaan, että asennettaisiin kauppa, jota Power PDF ei näytä.
changelog.nb: Installasjonsprogrammet kontrollerer nå Power PDF-rettelsespakken: Add-on Store krever Power PDF 2025.3.7 eller nyere. På en eldre versjon stopper installasjonen med en tydelig melding i stedet for å installere en butikk som Power PDF ikke viser.
changelog.sv: Installationsprogrammet kontrollerar nu Power PDF:s korrigeringspaket: Add-on Store kräver Power PDF 2025.3.7 eller senare. På en äldre version avbryts installationen med ett tydligt meddelande i stället för att installera en butik som Power PDF inte visar.
changelog.pl: Instalator sprawdza teraz pakiet poprawek Power PDF: Add-on Store wymaga programu Power PDF 2025.3.7 lub nowszego. W starszej wersji instalacja kończy się czytelnym komunikatem, zamiast instalować sklep, którego Power PDF nie pokazuje.
changelog.cs: Instalační program nyní kontroluje opravný balíček Power PDF: Add-on Store vyžaduje Power PDF 2025.3.7 nebo novější. U starší verze se instalace zastaví s jasnou zprávou, místo aby nainstalovala obchod, který Power PDF nezobrazí.
changelog.hu: A telepítő most ellenőrzi a Power PDF javítócsomagját: az Add-on Store a Power PDF 2025.3.7-es vagy újabb verzióját igényli. Régebbi verziónál a telepítés egyértelmű üzenettel leáll, ahelyett hogy olyan áruházat telepítene, amelyet a Power PDF nem jelenít meg.
changelog.ru: Программа установки теперь проверяет пакет исправлений Power PDF: для Add-on Store нужна версия Power PDF 2025.3.7 или новее. В более старой версии установка останавливается с понятным сообщением, а не устанавливает магазин, который Power PDF не показывает.
changelog.tr: Kurulum artık Power PDF düzeltme paketini denetliyor: Add-on Store için Power PDF 2025.3.7 veya üzeri gerekir. Daha eski bir sürümde kurulum, Power PDF tarafından gösterilmeyen bir mağaza yüklemek yerine açık bir mesajla durur.
changelog.zh-Hans: 安装程序现在会检查 Power PDF 的修补包：Add-on Store 需要 Power PDF 2025.3.7 或更高版本。在较旧版本上，安装会显示明确的提示并停止，而不是安装一个 Power PDF 不会显示的商店。
changelog.zh-Hant: 安裝程式現在會檢查 Power PDF 的修補程式套件：Add-on Store 需要 Power PDF 2025.3.7 或更新版本。在較舊版本上，安裝會顯示明確的提示並停止，而不是安裝一個 Power PDF 不會顯示的商店。
changelog.ja: インストーラーが Power PDF のフィックスパックを確認するようになりました。Add-on Store には Power PDF 2025.3.7 以降が必要です。古いバージョンでは、Power PDF に表示されないストアをインストールする代わりに、わかりやすいメッセージを表示してセットアップを中止します。
changelog.ko: 이제 설치 프로그램이 Power PDF 픽스 팩을 확인합니다. Add-on Store에는 Power PDF 2025.3.7 이상이 필요합니다. 이전 버전에서는 Power PDF에 표시되지 않는 스토어를 설치하는 대신 명확한 메시지와 함께 설치가 중단됩니다.
changelog.ar: يتحقق برنامج الإعداد الآن من حزمة إصلاحات Power PDF: يتطلب Add-on Store الإصدار 2025.3.7 أو أحدث من Power PDF. في الإصدار الأقدم يتوقف الإعداد برسالة واضحة بدلًا من تثبيت متجر لا يعرضه Power PDF.

complianceAudit.method: Checked all #include directives and linker inputs of PluginStore.vcxproj (Windows SDK incl. BCrypt/Crypt32 for SHA-256 and the ECDSA signature check, MFC/ATL, Tungsten Power PDF Plugin SDK only), the bundled UILayout and icon files (own work, icons drawn by client/res/make_icons.py) and the package contents. One third-party component: the Microsoft WebView2 SDK static loader (BSD-3-Clause), linked into PluginStore.zxt; its NOTICE lists only BSD-licensed .NET tooling that is not used. The bundled MSI is built with the WiX Toolset v3 (build tool; its standard WixUI dialog resources are part of the installer). No credentials, personal data or third-party trademarks in the package. The only network service is the configured Add-on Store server (HTTPS). The MSI also installs AddonStoreLink.exe (own code, no network access), which handles addonstore:// links by passing a validated package id to the client.

externalServices.name: Add-on Store server (configurable; default addon.power-pdf.de, Azure address ppdf-store.azurewebsites.net)
externalServices.data: Catalog, search and package downloads; sends the Power PDF UI language, the beta channel flag and, only when the user or IT entered one, the customer code of a delivery (X-Customer-Code header). The catalog is also read once in the background about 15 seconds after Power PDF starts and after the store window closes, to show the update badge (IT can switch this off with the policy UpdateBadge = 0). No personal data, no documents.

elevation.reason: Installing, updating and removing add-ons writes to Power PDF's Plug-Ins folder in Program Files: one PowerShell step runs elevated after the UAC prompt, only when the user installs, updates or removes an add-on (the self-update starts msiexec the same way).
